posts.title: Cross-Account and Cross-Region Backups with AWS Backup (and friends)
posts.description: In today’s edition of “don’t trust LLMs”, we learn that despite what AI tells you, AWS Backup doesn’t support Cross-Account and Cross-Region backups.
